payload.name: EPO Linked Open EP Data
payload.note: The 15 November research logged successful bibliographic queries and one official claims-bearing XML representation. EP bibliographic, family and classification coverage; not worldwide full text. Some linked representations contain only metadata. Review as a separate discovery service from Open Patent Services; use bulk products for heavy collection.

payload.name: USPTO Patent Public Search — export limits
payload.note: The 15 November audit corrected the earlier interpretation of 500 rows: this is an auto-loaded batch, not a hard export ceiling. The recorded official guidance allows up to 10,000 exported documents and a 20,000-result buffer. Family members must be expanded and counts reconciled. Treat this as a dated correction requiring curator review; not a new source.

payload.name: CIPO — weekly XML is not necessarily full text
payload.note: The supplied weekly update part contained 325 A1 XML records, 321 abstracts and no claims or descriptions. It is one part of a weekly update, not a Canadian corpus or publication-date cohort. Keep abstract/metadata access distinct from full-text access. Further Canadian bulk-claims access remains unresolved.
